lines: THE COUNTY IS YOURS. All {nodes} nodes held.{rivals} Somewhere, a regional manager is updating a spreadsheet with shaking hands.
THE COUNTY IS YOURS. Every one of {nodes} nodes answers to the lab.{rivals} The county line is now a suggestion you make.
The coalition does not concede. It reschedules. Counter-offensives continue.
The coalition has stopped calling it a war and started calling it a quarterly review. It continues.

THE LABS ARE OPEN. All five rival collections are unaccounted for at once. A joint statement describes the timing as “coincidental” and the county as “broadly fine.”
Every containment door in the county opened within the same hour. Five laboratories report nothing missing, in writing, at length.
County-wide advisory: rival stock is loose in numbers, in combinations nobody filed paperwork for, and some of it is carrying things that were not on the manifest.

ticker: Local zoo reports goat shortage. Authorities baffled.
